title: Restocking Rounds, Planogram Changes and Call-Out Charges across the Micro Market Formats
content:
Field operations serve each Unattended Micro Market Program format on a printed rhythm: a number of scheduled restocking visits each week, a length for each of those visits, the notice in calendar days needed to change the planogram, the number of planned planogram refreshes in a year, and the charge for an unscheduled restocking visit asked for by the client.

| Market format | Scheduled restocking visits each week | Length of each visit, hours | Planogram change notice, calendar days | Planned planogram refreshes each year | Unscheduled call-out charge, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cooler & Snack Wall | 1 | 2 | 14 | 1 | 85 |
| Compact Micro Market | 2 | 2.5 | 14 | 2 | 110 |
| Standard Micro Market | 3 | 3 | 21 | 4 | 145 |
| Fresh Food Micro Market | 5 | 4 | 21 | 6 | 185 |
| Expanded Campus Micro Market | 5 | 6 | 30 | 6 | 240 |
| Smart Store Micro Market | 3 | 3.5 | 21 | 12 | 165 |

## Basis questions the schedule answers

**How often is a Fresh Food Micro Market restocked, and for how long?** Five scheduled visits each week, each of 4 hours.

**Which formats share a planogram change notice of 21 calendar days?** The Standard Micro Market, the Fresh Food Micro Market and the Smart Store Micro Market. The two smallest formats take 14 calendar days, and the Expanded Campus Micro Market takes 30.

**What does an unscheduled restocking visit cost at a Compact Micro Market?** 110 USD. The same call-out at an Expanded Campus Micro Market is 240 USD.

The Smart Store Micro Market carries the most frequent planned planogram refresh of any format, at 12 each year, while restocking only 3 times each week.
